note: One Goal Between Us — the Belgium–Türkiye history, argued by the two rivals in two interview rooms. Fictional synthetic voices: Kokoro reference timbres (am_onyx for TR #9, am_fenrir for BE #4) → Chatterbox delivery. Facts (dates, venues, scores) verified 2026-10-01 against TFF / UEFA / ESPN; real scorers are named where verified (Oliveira 1997, Mpenza 2009, Hamit/Semih/Arda 2010; Rüştü 2000) — by owner decision; the 2000 scorer is deliberately not named. Each line carries `tr`: the burned-in Turkish subtitle (audio stays English).

NINE.ref_text: Most mornings I wake up before everyone else. The house is quiet. I make the coffee, I sit by the window, and I think about the day ahead.

FOUR.who: BE-PLAYER-04 (Belgium #4, the campaign's Lucas), in his interview room
FOUR.ref_text: Most mornings I wake up before everyone else. The house is quiet. I make the coffee, I sit by the window, and I think about the day ahead.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: …Their waffles are very good.

lines.speaker: FOUR
lines.text: The fans. They are loud. Very, very loud.

lines.speaker: FOUR
lines.text: It started in 1957, in Ankara. One–all.
lines.say: It started in nineteen fifty-seven, in Ankara. One all.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: A year later, in Brussels. One–all again.
lines.say: A year later, in Brussels. One all, again.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: Very polite.

lines.speaker: FOUR
lines.text: Very polite.

lines.speaker: FOUR
lines.text: Then 1997, in Istanbul. Luis Oliveira scored three. 3–1, and we went to the World Cup.
lines.say: Then ninety-seven, in Istanbul. Luis Oliveira scored three. Three one, and we went to the World Cup.
lines.tr: Sonra 1997, İstanbul. Luis Oliveira üç gol attı. 3–1 kazandık ve Dünya Kupası'na gittik.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: I was one year old.

lines.speaker: FOUR
lines.text: I was three. I remember everything.
lines.tr: Ben üç yaşındaydım. Her şeyi hatırlıyorum.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: June 2000. The Euros, in Brussels. Their tournament, their stadium. We won 2–0 and sent the hosts home.
lines.say: June two thousand. The Euros, in Brussels. Their tournament, their stadium. We won two nil, and sent the hosts home.
lines.tr: Haziran 2000. Avrupa Şampiyonası, Brüksel. Onların turnuvası, onların stadı. 2–0 kazandık ve ev sahibini evine gönderdik.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: My father lifted me so high, I hit the lamp.
lines.tr: Babam beni öyle yükseğe kaldırdı ki kafamı lambaya çarptım.

lines.speaker: FOUR
lines.text: I was six. We were hosting it, and we went out at home. I cried for a week.
lines.tr: Altı yaşındaydım. Turnuva bizdeydi ve kendi evimizde elendik. Bir hafta ağladım.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: We celebrated for a week.

lines.speaker: FOUR
lines.text: 2009, in Brussels. Émile Mpenza scored twice. 2–0 to us.
lines.say: Two thousand nine, in Brussels. Emile Mpenza scored twice. Two nil to us.
lines.tr: 2009, Brüksel. Émile Mpenza iki gol attı. 2–0 bizim.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: I don't remember that one.

lines.speaker: FOUR
lines.text: He remembers.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: Istanbul, 2010. Hamit scored, Semih scored, and Arda won it in the 78th minute. 3–2.
lines.say: Istanbul, twenty ten. Hamit scored, Semih scored, and Arda won it in the seventy-eighth minute. Three two.
lines.tr: İstanbul, 2010. Hamit attı, Semih attı, 78. dakikada Arda bitirdi. 3–2.

lines.speaker: FOUR
lines.text: You beat our kids. We came with a team of teenagers.
lines.tr: Bizim çocukları yendiniz. Neredeyse gençlerden kurulu bir takımla gelmiştik.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: Your kids were very good.

lines.speaker: FOUR
lines.text: Those kids became our golden generation.
lines.tr: O çocuklar bizim altın jenerasyonumuz oldu.

lines.speaker: FOUR
lines.text: Eleven matches. Belgium scored eighteen goals, Türkiye seventeen.
lines.tr: On bir maç. Belçika on sekiz gol attı, Türkiye on yedi.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: Three wins each.

lines.speaker: FOUR
lines.text: Eighteen goals.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: Five draws.

lines.speaker: FOUR
lines.text: We're one goal ahead.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: And it's been fifteen years since we last played.
lines.tr: Ve en son on beş yıl önce karşılaştık.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: My father watched every one of these matches with me.
lines.tr: Babam bu maçların hepsini benimle izledi.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: He's not here for this one.

lines.speaker: FOUR
lines.text: …Then let's make it a good one for him.
lines.say: Then let's make it a good one for him.
lines.tr: …O zaman onun için güzel bir maç yapalım.

lines.speaker: FOUR
lines.text: Eighteen, seventeen.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: Not after tomorrow.

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: Two goals. And Rüştü was a wall in goal.
lines.tr: İki gol. Kalede de Rüştü duvar gibiydi.
lines.say: Two goals. And Rushtu was a wall in goal.
